name: Unlearning Night Hunter's Howl removes its book-only ranks too (#13141)
contract: Night Hunter's Howl 500124 comes from talent entry 9705 (CharacterAdvancement.dbc). Its ranks 2-5
(501680-501683) have spell_ranks rows, so Player::removeSpell's chain walk removes them with the talent.
Ranks 6-8 (501684-501686) are sold only through the Books of Ascension upgrade rows in
modules/mod-spellbook/src/SpellbookRankData.h, which require rank 4 (501682) and have no spell_ranks
rows, so unlearning the talent left them on the character (#13141: 'removes ranks 1-4 but not 5-6').
Expected: unlearning the talent removes rank 6 with rank 4. Picking the talent again gives the chain
ranks back as before, and summoning the Book of Ascension gives rank 6 back for free. Before the fix
rank 6 stayed known (1) after the talent was unlearned.
Entry 9705 sits in the Eternal tab (53, specialization 99) behind 8 invested Talent Essence, so the
character first spends 8 points on ungated one-point talents of that tab.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Enter Eternal, the tree that holds the talent
SETUP: invest Talent Essence in Eternal
Unlearn Night Hunter's Howl in the talent window
CONTROL: unlearning the talent removes rank 1
CONTROL: the chain walk removes rank 4
DISCRIMINATING: rank 6 is removed with rank 4
Picking the talent again gives rank 4 back
The book gives the remembered rank 6 back
Getting rank 6 back costs no gold
